recipes.subject: PIPELINE SURPRISE #2 (undocumented, contradicts stage's own help text): `bp task stage <doc_id> open` SUCCEEDED on a done task and flipped lifecycle_status done -> open (epoch unchanged at 6, rev changed). The stage command's own --help text states the legal transition table as 'considering<->researching; considering|researching->open; open->considering; same->same' and says an illegal transition '(e.g. -> done)' 422s — it does NOT document done->open as legal, nor warn it is possible. This is the actual unblock mechanism for stamping a merge-gated criterion on an already-closed reconciliation row, and it is undocumented/surprising behavior that every one of the other 14 rows may need if they are similarly already-done rather than merely lapsed-in_progress.
